description:
A crew of developers, data analysts, and space enthusiasts united for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Combining backgrounds in Machine Learning, Geospatial Analysis, digital design and Full-Stack Engineering , we leverage NASA’s open-source satellite data to build scalable, tech-forward solutions for complex challenges on Earth and beyond.

AI •Machine Learning•Data Analysis • Geospatial Analysis •3D Visualization • Python•JavaScript •Full-Stack Development•UI/UX•Data Management • Risk Assessment
